import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
s=json.load(open('/app/output/spec.json'))
axes=np.array(s['proprio']['axis']); pivots=np.array(s['proprio']['position_m']); limits=np.array(s['action_types']['joint_position']['range_rad'])
q0=np.zeros(19);q0[[12,14,16,18]]=[3.11,1.49,-3.11,1.49]

def arm(q,side):
    ids=range(11,15) if side==0 else range(15,19)
    R=np.eye(3);t=np.zeros(3)
    for i in ids:
        Ri=Rotation.from_rotvec(axes[i]*q[i]).as_matrix()
        t=t+R@(pivots[i]-Ri@pivots[i]);R=R@Ri
    return R, R@pivots[list(ids)[-1]]+t
fixed=[arm(q0,i) for i in range(2)]

def solve(theta,prev=None):
    B=Rotation.from_rotvec([0,theta,0]).as_matrix()
    def fun(x):
        q=q0.copy();q[11:]=x[3:]
        out=[]
        for side in range(2):
            R,p=arm(q,side);Rf,pf=fixed[side]
            out.extend((B@p+x[:3]-pf)*3)
            out.extend(Rotation.from_matrix(Rf.T@B@R).as_rotvec())
        return out
    x=np.r_[np.zeros(3),q0[11:]] if prev is None else prev
    lo=np.r_[[-3]*3, limits[11:,0]];hi=np.r_[[3]*3,limits[11:,1]]
    sol=least_squares(fun,np.clip(x,lo+1e-8,hi-1e-8),bounds=(lo,hi),max_nfev=500,xtol=1e-11,ftol=1e-11,gtol=1e-11)
    return sol.x,np.linalg.norm(sol.fun)
if __name__=='__main__':
    x=None
    for th in np.linspace(0,np.pi,33):
        x,err=solve(th,x)
        print(round(th,3),round(err,4),np.round(x,3).tolist())

def action(q):
 return np.clip(2*(np.asarray(q)-limits[:,0])/(limits[:,1]-limits[:,0])-1,-1,1)

def run(A,note):
 stages=json.loads((OUT/'commands.json').read_text()) if (OUT/'commands.json').exists() else []
 stages.append({'note':note,'actions':np.asarray(A).tolist()}); (OUT/'commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(stages))

 return res

cat >> /app/output/gen.py <<'PY'

def pump(steps=100):
    """Add energy using measured pitch velocity, checking every two steps."""
    res=r.get_obs(cameras=['room_camera'],video='none')
    p=np.array(res.meta['proprio']['now']);direction=1 if p[39]>=0 else -1
    hist=[];stages=json.loads((OUT/'commands.json').read_text())
    for i in range(0,steps,2):
        if p[39]>.2:direction=1
        elif p[39]<-.2:direction=-1
        q=np.zeros(19);q[12]=3.11;q[16]=-3.11
        q[[11,15]]=-2.87*direction;q[[14,18]]=2.61 if direction>0 else -1.25
        q[[2,7]]=-2.8 if direction>0 else .4;q[[3,8]]=.7 if direction>0 else 0
        A=np.tile(action(q),(min(2,steps-i),1))
        stages.append({'note':'IMU swing pump','actions':A.tolist()});(OUT/'commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(stages))
        res=r.submit('joint_position',A,dt=.02,cameras=['room_camera'],video='none')
        p=np.array(res.meta['proprio']['now']);theta=np.arctan2(p[41],-p[43]);hist.append([res.meta['control_steps'],theta,p[39],direction,*p[:19]])
        if i%10==0:print('swing',res.meta['control_steps'],round(theta,3),round(p[39],3),direction,flush=True)
        if res.done or abs(theta)>1.8:
            print('stop',res.meta['done'],res.meta['reason'],theta,flush=True);break
    np.save(OUT/f"pump_{res.meta['control_steps']:04d}.npy",hist);res.save(str(OUT/f"stage_{res.meta['control_steps']:04d}"))
    return res
PY

import base64
import json

def main():
